What Mom whispered, every night: the same six words. 🌙 "Take heart. Do not be afraid."

At five, Amara hid under the blanket. Mom whispered them. At nine, after a hard day: "I'm sorry I…" and then the six words. ❤️ At thirteen, faced away into her pillow: "You're still my girl." And the six words.

At seventeen, she left home. Far away, on a dark night, she whispered them to herself. ✨

Thirty years later, the night before, Mom lay in a hospital bed. Amara climbed up beside her and whispered the six words back. Mom smiled: "I know." 🥹❤️

Jesus said them first, walking on the water in the storm: "Take heart; it is I. Do not be afraid." Matthew 14:27 (ESV) 🙏 Then He walked into the darkest night of all at the cross, so our kids never have to face the dark alone.

The last voice your child hears at night becomes the voice they carry. ❤️ Tonight's whisper: "Take heart. Do not be afraid."

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
